subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: Should maintainers adopt the shared durable queue drainer and sealed authenticated requeue contract as the repair lane's production operating model once exact-head checks finish?
rationale: Tests support the implementation, but the patch intentionally changes central automation-liveness and authorization contracts whose long-term operational ownership requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt after final gate
options.body: Merge after the current exact-head checks complete successfully and the reviewed operational contract is accepted.

options.title: Split risky surfaces
options.body: Land independent proof and validation hardening separately, then review queue and requeue changes in a narrower PR.

options.title: Pause adoption
options.body: Keep the current repair operating model and substantially rework or close this draft if the new interfaces are not acceptable.

recommendation.title: Adopt after final gate
recommendation.body: Merge after the current exact-head checks complete successfully and the reviewed operational contract is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the repository member with the strongest current-main and branch history across the affected repair architecture.
